# DbTree - https://dbtree.app
> DbTree is a Windows desktop SQL client that visualizes PostgreSQL relational databases as interactive hierarchical trees. Navigate foreign key relationships by clicking instead of writing JOIN queries.

## Key pages
- Homepage: https://dbtree.app/
- Download: https://dbtree.app/download
- Contact: https://dbtree.app/contact

## Product
- Name: DbTree
- Version: 1.0.0 (released 2026-01-10)
- Platform: Windows 10/11 x64
- Database support: PostgreSQL 9.6+
